t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep fingers on the right keys and make sure to use the breaks. They got fewer points from blue and green.

vb_textbox.text: Keep your fingers on the correct buttons and respond in time to make sure you at least earn something. Make sure to use the breaks as it gets quite tiring otherwise. I think I got more points on orange and dark pink and tended to get fewer with blue and green but that could just be down to luck. I wasn't sure if the colours and points switched depending on x1 and x5.
